subject: Bihar Special
question: In which of the following years was the Patna High Court established?
explanation: The Patna High Court was established on 9 February 1916 and commenced functioning under Sir Edward Chamier as first Chief Justice.
distractor_notes: 1912: Bihar & Orissa carved out; 1919: Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms; 1921: Legislative Council constituted.

subject: Modern History
question: Who was the first President of the Bihar Provincial Congress Committee formed in 1908 at Sonpur?
explanation: In 1908, a meeting was held at Sonpur under the presidency of Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan where BPCC was formally constituted.
distractor_notes: Mazharul Haque and Sachchidananda Sinha were delegates; Hasan Imam presided in 1909.

subject: Bihar Special
question: Who founded the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) in 1929 to mobilize peasants against zamindari exploitation?
explanation: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati formed the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) in 1929 at Sonpur Mela.
distractor_notes: Karyanand Sharma led Barahiya Tal; Rahul Sankrityayan led Ambhari; Yadunandan Sharma led Reora.
